gaps: Pause-job button fate and card route ownership after the prose-card removal (R2a/R2b).

Two draft errors proved by the four Codex sol@xhigh validation passes: compound Allow-once wording violated 0134/0144 (pipes are reformulation-only), and the risk-gated-family claim had no enforcement point (0121: autonomous runs are classifier-free; reviewed-rule matches return before rails).
resolutions: R1a: family breadth for all simple external commands, risk-gated — deterministic rails evaluate the exact command before a family match is honored; a rail hit asks and permits Allow-once only (ratified R2c).
R1b: one canonical card for ALL need classes; every JobSetupActionShape gets a row/action mapping; the setup-pause prompt implementation folds into the job permission card.
R2a: Pause job button dropped — a blocked job is already paused; the neutral kind, callback variants and provider codecs are deleted with the prose card.
R2b: approver route alone owns the card; other notification routes see nothing until the terminal outcome.
R2c: both corrections ratified — pipes never get Allow (retry-and-ask stays the compound-row action for paused jobs); rails-before-family-match ordering change gets its own decision record.

All four validation passes folded into the spec: one shared family-rule synthesizer across the three grant lanes; canonical family shape is the existing trailing-star argv grammar plus a durable-validator amendment; Allow creates zero rerun barriers/triggers (kills the per-dead-priorRunId fanout); tap-time lease check returns live|late; notified_fingerprint ownership moves to card delivery; 0144 Reconsider rows exempt from collapse; family grants live in agent authority only (0106); the #462 interactive host lane is retained for Run now.

rounds.question: Spec grill R1a — family-breadth boundary: 'Allow curl ⇒ curl with anything' is clear for network/read tools. Should the SAME family breadth apply to destructive binaries (rm, dd, git push --force, sudo…), or do those stay exact-argv/per-ask?
options: Family only for a safe list

rounds.question: Spec grill R1b — does killing the 'Setup needed' message also apply to NON-tool blockers (missing credential, capability install, channel setup) that today carry grantable setup actions on that card?
options: Yes — one card for all needs (Recommended)
rounds.chosen: Yes — one card for all needs (Recommended)

rounds.question: Grill R2a — the Pause job button (shipped in CARDFIX-1 on the prose card): keep it as an action on the canonical permission card, or drop it entirely (a job blocked on a need is already paused; Deny just leaves it paused)?
options: Keep Pause job on the card

rounds.question: Grill R2b — who gets the card? Today prose notifications go to ALL configured notification routes, while permission prompts go only to the approver route. Under one-card, who sees it?

Grill R2c — ratify two corrections Codex proved against the code: (1) PIPED commands never get an Allow button at all (reformulation-only — 0134/0144 already mandate this; my draft wrongly offered Allow-once); retry-and-ask remains the compound-row action for paused jobs. (2) 'Risk-gated family' needs a real mechanism: rails evaluate the exact command BEFORE a family match is honored; a rail hit asks, and that Allow is once-only.
